title: Nvidia Lost $1 Trillion in 9 Days, COP31 Collapses, Ukraine War Widens | Daily Crux
description_html:
Nvidia has brought back CEO Jensen Huang and Wall Street jumped about 5 percent in a morning, but was the AI crash a real warning or just a panic? Also today: the longest climate summit in history ends in Antalya with no deal, and the war in Ukraine now reaches Poland, the Baltic and Libya. Plus world headlines from Iran, the US midterms and Asia, and what India's record foreign inflows mean.
